NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VIII: OUR OWN STORIES, SKILLS AND FUTURE (LCH-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
From the owner's Volume IV concepts (301-400): telling our own stories, who owns a song or a design, research the village asks for, caregivers and builders, seeds that came home, makers and stargazers, terrible singing, newcomers who stay, and an island that belongs to its people.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: Farmers and builders want to dig water channels to the dry gardens: follow the land's slope, or dig straight and fast.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) wants water channels from the stream to the dry gardens. (friend), who builds, says a straight channel would be fastest. (subject) says water does not like straight lines, and the channel should follow the land. What should they dig?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The channel winds across the hillside like a snake. It takes twice as long to dig. The water flows smoothly into every garden. (friend) admits the water seems to like it.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The straight channel is dug in a week. The water rushes down it, overflows at the bend and floods the bean garden. They fix it. It ends up winding after all.
